description: Homebrew deep residual caches beyond top-level $HOME/Library/Caches/Homebrew and $HOME/Library/Logs/Homebrew already shipped: HOMEBREW_CACHE variants (Linux/XDG), nested downloads/Cask/api/bootsnap/build tool caches, bottle temp cellar, portable-ruby download and vendor leftovers, linuxbrew home tree, brew bundle dump artifacts (report-only), formula JSON/API caches, tap git leftovers (report-only), logs deeper structure, Cellar/opt/Caskroom inventory (report-only never wipe), mas/App Store CLI-related caches, and cask zap residual pattern notes. Prefer brew cleanup / brew cleanup -s / brew autoremove for prefix maintenance.

risk_policy.nested_download_api_build_caches: low; contents-only + min_age; regenerable via brew fetch/update
risk_policy.temp_cellar_locks_incomplete: low or medium; aged only; skip in-progress locks
risk_policy.portable_ruby_vendor_installed: report-only or medium (old versions only; brew cleanup manages)
risk_policy.cask_zap_user_data: report-only; use brew uninstall --cask --zap per token; do not bulk-delete Application Support

notes: Top-level macos-homebrew-cache and macos-homebrew-logs already cover default macOS cache/log roots. This batch adds nested subcaches, alternate HOMEBREW_CACHE locations, prefix var/tmp, and adjacent tools (mas App Store caches). /usr/local Intel prefix is runtime never-touch under /usr; list /opt/homebrew (Apple Silicon default) for prefix paths. Prefer native: brew cleanup, brew cleanup -s, brew autoremove, brew untap, brew uninstall --cask --zap TOKEN.

rules.name: Homebrew HOMEBREW_CACHE alternate roots
rules.description: Non-default or Linux-style Homebrew download cache roots when HOMEBREW_CACHE or XDG layout is used.
rules.notes: Default macOS is $HOME/Library/Caches/Homebrew (already covered). Linux default is $XDG_CACHE_HOME/Homebrew or ~/.cache/Homebrew. HOMEBREW_CACHE env overrides brew --cache; expand is not automatic so alternate concrete roots are listed.

rules.name: Homebrew downloads and Cask subcache
rules.description: Nested bottle/source downloads and Cask artifact cache under Homebrew cache (symlinks at cache root point into downloads/).
rules.notes: Largest reclaim under brew --cache. Incomplete *.incomplete files are partial downloads. Prefer brew cleanup before blind wipe.

rules.name: Homebrew formula/cask API JSON cache
rules.description: Cached formula.jws.json, cask.jws.json, names/aliases lists, and internal packages envelopes used by API mode.
rules.notes: HOMEBREW_CACHE_API. Regenerated on brew update. Safe wipe; next brew command refetches. Internal packages.*.jws.json can be large.

rules.name: Homebrew API source formula cache
rules.description: api-source tree caching formula.rb and patches fetched via the formulae API.
rules.notes: HOMEBREW_CACHE_API_SOURCE. brew cleanup prunes empty dirs and aged files. Not installed Cellar content.

rules.name: Homebrew Bootsnap Ruby compile cache
rules.description: Bootsnap cache for Homebrew Ruby when HOMEBREW_BOOTSNAP is enabled.
rules.notes: Regenerates quickly; brew cleanup already removes non-current bootsnap keys. Harmless reclaim.

rules.name: Homebrew nested formula build tool caches
rules.description: Per-build caches Homebrew places under HOMEBREW_CACHE for formula builds (cargo, go, java, npm, pip, glide, gclient).
rules.notes: cleanup.rb nested_cache? list. go_cache/go_mod_cache are often chmod read-only; may need chmod before delete. Not the user global cargo/go caches under ~/.cargo or ~/go.

rules.name: Homebrew gh-actions-artifact cache
rules.description: Cached GitHub Actions artifacts under Homebrew cache (CI bottle/source staging).
rules.notes: Scrubbed by brew cleanup. Safe if present.

rules.name: Homebrew linkage and description cache DBs
rules.description: linkage.db and desc_cache.json metadata under Homebrew cache root.
rules.notes: File-level metadata only under cache root (not full cache wipe). Recreated on next brew doctor/cleanup/update. Do not use this rule to wipe downloads/ without the dedicated downloads rule.

rules.name: Homebrew portable-ruby download cache
rules.description: Downloaded portable-ruby tarballs/directories under HOMEBREW_CACHE (not the active vendor install).
rules.notes: Historical portable-ruby-* dirs and downloads/*portable-ruby* artifacts. Active Ruby lives under Library/Homebrew/vendor/portable-ruby (separate report-only rule).

rules.name: Homebrew portable-ruby vendor install (report-only)
rules.description: Installed portable-ruby under Homebrew vendor; brew cleanup removes non-current versions only.
rules.notes: Do not rm current portable-ruby; brew will break. Inventory size only; prefer brew cleanup for old versions.

rules.name: Homebrew bottle temp cellar and prefix tmp
rules.description: Temporary bottle extract staging under prefix var/homebrew/tmp (.cellar) and build temp.
rules.notes: HOMEBREW_TEMP_CELLAR = prefix/var/homebrew/tmp/.cellar. Safe after idle installs. Skip if brew install is running. Intel /usr/local prefix is never-touch under /usr in ppduster; not listed.

rules.name: Homebrew stale formula/cask lock files
rules.description: Aged lock files under prefix var/homebrew/locks left after interrupted brew operations.
rules.notes: HOMEBREW_LOCKS. Only remove aged unlocked locks; never delete active locks during brew. Prefer brew cleanup.

rules.name: Homebrew logs deeper and Linux log layout
rules.description: Per-formula log directories under Homebrew logs plus Linux XDG log layout variants.
rules.notes: macOS default HOMEBREW_LOGS is ~/Library/Logs/Homebrew (top-level also shipped). Structure is one subdir per formula name. Linux uses cache/Homebrew/Logs. HOMEBREW_LOGS env can override.

rules.name: Linuxbrew/Homebrew under $HOME caches
rules.description: User-tree Homebrew/Linuxbrew prefix caches and tmp (not Cellar).
rules.notes: Complements exotic-linuxbrew in batch 21 with tmp/cache focus. Standard macOS /opt/homebrew is separate. Do not wipe Cellar here.

rules.name: Linuxbrew home Cellar/opt (report-only)
rules.description: Installed formulae under user linuxbrew/homebrew prefixes; inventory only.
rules.notes: Never bulk-delete Cellar. Use brew uninstall / autoremove.

rules.name: Homebrew Cellar opt Caskroom (report-only)
rules.description: Installed formula kegs, opt symlinks, and Caskroom versions under default Apple Silicon prefix.
rules.notes: Report size only. Never wipe Cellar/opt/Caskroom. Old kegs: brew cleanup. Orphan casks: brew uninstall --cask. *.reinstall dirs under Cellar cleaned by brew cleanup.

rules.name: Homebrew taps git repos (report-only)
rules.description: Tapped formula/cask git repositories; git object bloat after many updates is reclaimable only via git gc, not rm.
rules.notes: Do not delete .git or tap trees blindly. Unused taps: brew untap. Git pack leftovers: git gc inside tap repos. Core API mode may have few local taps.

rules.name: brew bundle Brewfile dumps (report-only)
rules.description: User Brewfile snapshots from brew bundle dump; intentional state, not caches.
rules.notes: HOMEBREW_BUNDLE_FILE / global Brewfile locations. Never auto-delete; users keep these for machine setup.

rules.name: mas / Mac App Store user caches
rules.description: User Library caches used by Mac App Store and related agents (mas CLI drives MAS installs; no large private mas cache).
rules.notes: mas-cli itself stores little; App Store download/metadata caches are regenerable. Does not uninstall MAS apps or receipts. Leave Preferences and account state alone.

rules.name: Cask zap residual user patterns (report-only)
rules.description: Document common user-Library residual roots left after brew uninstall --cask without --zap. Inventory guidance only; no bulk wipe.
rules.notes: zap stanzas typically trash per-token paths under Application Support, Caches, HTTPStorages, Logs, Preferences, Saved Application State, WebKit, Cookies. NEVER bulk-clean these roots. Report-only for awareness; reclaim only via brew uninstall --cask --zap or targeted known leftovers. Preferences/Cookies risk user settings.
